sources.quote: BR-220 at TO1 for STL has one approved material source: Alluminio B S.r.l. (Settimo Torinese).
A source that is not listed for a part, plant and customer has no approval.
Approval is granted per part, per receiving plant and per customer, never per supplier.

findings.why: Meccanica C S.p.A. has no approval for BR-220 at TO1 for STL. Its only approvals are BR-180 (TO1, STL) and BR-310 (TO2, CLM). The record is the complete list, so the absence means no approval. The audit and the BR-180 approval do not carry over to BR-220.

part BR-220 (drawing Rev C); program STL-Torino-27; customer STL; material EN AW-6082-T6; features: 4 fastener holes
per il BR-220 il materiale e' EN AW-6061-T6 con Rp0.2 minimo 240 MPa, quindi il billet di C va bene.

findings.why: The drawing in force (Rev C) requires EN AW-6082-T6. Meccanica C offers EN AW-6061-T6, which is a different grade. The email says 6061-T6 is acceptable, but it is not a controlled record. It conflicts with Rev C, and Rev B is withdrawn. The supplier's claim of equivalent strength does not change the grade the drawing requires.
